findings.summary: `swapUsedDeltaMb` is incorrectly constrained to be `.nonnegative()`, which will cause validation failures if system swap usage decreases during the certification run.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove `.nonnegative()` from `swapUsedDeltaMb` in `CertificationTelemetryDataSchema` and remove the corresponding negative-value test in `ltx-certification.test.ts`.
